title: Sunflower Chain Whip Girl
description: A female character with spiky black hair and sunflower accessories is shown in three distinct poses against a striped green background. She wears a yellow and black outfit with a corset, shorts, and boots, and wields a long black whip-like tail ending in a sunflower.
prompt: A tough anime girl with spiky black hair, yellow sunflower hair accessories and matching armbands, wearing a yellow and black corset top with skull details, short skirt, black thigh-high stockings with garters, and heavy yellow boots. She has a long black segmented whip tail ending in a sunflower. Shown in three poses: crouching on the left, dynamic jumping pose in the center with arms raised, and a low fighting stance on the right, all against a vibrant green striped background, comic book style, clean lines, bold colors
